name: Motomiya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Motomiya city emblem in green and blue: a disc of green above and blue below, divided by a white sweeping stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Motomiya, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 2007.

features.role: Motomiya city emblem — a disc of green above and blue below, divided by a white sweeping stroke
